constraints.name: seat_adjacency_definition
constraints.formal: For any row, seat i and seat j are adjacent iff {i,j} ∈ {{1,2},{3,4},{4,5},{5,6},{7,8}}.

constraints.name: group_separation_on_adjacent_seats
constraints.description: 任意两个相邻座位上不能坐着来自不同组的士兵。
constraints.formal: If two seats are adjacent and both occupied, the soldiers occupying them must belong to the same group.

constraints.name: valid_seat_assignment
constraints.description: 所有士兵必须被分配到座位上,且每个座位最多容纳一名士兵。
constraints.formal: The placement is a function from soldiers to seats that is injective, assigning each soldier to exactly one seat.
